## Requirements (contract)

1. **Bounded adapters for the three pilot dossier source families
   (`dossier_okc`, `dossier_tulsa`, `dossier_san_diego`) over the common
   eight-stage connector interface** — SIG-ACQ-003.
2. **Fixed protocol/interface caps (≤2 document protocols), a frozen named-target
   crosswalk to existing predicates/qualifiers/roles/valid-time/dossier field,
   genre-aware semantics, and explicit bounded failure** — never partial or
   ad-hoc extraction.
3. **Keep every new source row blocked** (`ingestion_permitted=false`, rights
   UNDETERMINED, no review metadata) — fixture success proves engineering, not
   rights.

### Out of scope (must NOT do)

- No live fetch, no `ingestion_permitted` flip, no `rights_decision` minted, no
  operator/human-review fabrication.
- No OCR or third parser protocol; no new parsing stack.
- No ad-hoc ontology terms — unmapped fields route through the recorded scoped
  amendment.
- No plate-, trip-, per-search-, or person-level ingestion.
- No merge, tag, push to `main`, branch deletion, force-push.

## Plan

- **`connectors/src/connectors/dossier_documents.py`** — the registered
  `DossierDocumentsConnector` over the standard eight stages:
  `discover` (targets from `live_targets.toml`), `fetch` (the only egress —
  fixture transport in tests), `capture` (content-addressed store),
  `parse` (`clause_fields` / `index_listing` handlers over `html_text` /
  `pdf_text`), `extract` (field-state engine: locate reviewed literals in
  bytes → typed locators → claim rows), `normalize` (vocab-version stamp),
  `link` (`sig.org.name_scoped` entity-ref twins), `load` (claim ids +
  system-period metadata). Guards: resource bounds, derived+reviewed genre,
  `template_execution_guard`, `subscription_hardware_guard`, D6 stamping,
  Part VIII forbidden-token/person-naming (shared `okc_documents`
  implementation).
- **`data/dossier_documents_vocab.toml`** (`dossier-documents/1`) —
  protocols, genre guards, non-probative genres, default sensitivity C1,
  field-state vocabulary, resource bounds.
- **`data/dossier_field_crosswalk.toml`** (`dossier-field-crosswalk/1`) —
  field → predicate/object_role-or-object_type/dossier_field(q1..q12)/
  valid_time/applicability/required/status; `execution_state` admitted as
  `needs_amendment` with the scoped `instrument_execution_state` proposal.
- **`check_crosswalk()`** — validates every configured field against the
  crosswalk and every mapped predicate against
  `ontology.generate.load_vocab()` (new public accessor — no duplicated
  predicate list); wired into `sig-connectors validate`.
- **Registry wiring** — three `sources.toml` rows (blocked), twelve
  `live_targets.toml` targets, `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` entries,
  `connectors/__init__.py` import, `connectors/pyproject.toml` +
  `sig-ontology` dep (acyclic — ontology imports nothing downstream).
- **Fixtures** — `tests/connectors/fixtures/dossier/`: 10 representative
  stand-in documents + `malformed_document.pdf` + `SOURCES.md` +
  `golden_locators.json`.
- **Tests** — `tests/connectors/test_dossier_documents.py` (40 tests).
- **ADR-131** — the shared-adapter + frozen-crosswalk contract; Appendix F
  row; BL-058 mapping; `COVERAGE_MATRIX` SIG-ACQ-003 → MET.
- **DEFERRALS** — `D-R10-SOURCES-1` annotated (advanced, stays OPEN).
- **Closeout** — this file, `pr/P32.12.md`, BUILD_INDEX row 172, LEDGER
  advance (lastCompleted P32.12, nextTicket P32.13, chainTip),
  `check-build-memory.sh` green.

| Typed locators | byte ranges (HTML/index), page locators (PDF); golden file committed | MET |
| Genre-aware semantics | derived + reviewed genre recorded; template/subscription guards; D6 on non-probative genres | MET |
| Temporal discipline | valid_time classes; `none` bars promotion; posted/effective/coverage/as_of stay distinct | MET |
| Field completeness, no synthetic certainty | answered/present_but_empty/absent → field-state evidence; redacted → `somevalue` | MET |
| Bounded explicit failure | bytes/pages/fields/text/links bounds; malformed/encrypted/unsupported explicit | MET |
| Part VIII | shared `okc_documents` guard — consumed, not forked; no plate/person data in fixtures | MET |
| Rows blocked; no fabricated review/rights | `ingestion_permitted=false` ×3; loader gate refuses; no review metadata | MET |
| Replay/shadow/socket-free | deterministic replay; shadow zero-diff; `transport.requested` stays empty on replay | MET |
| Anything not automatically verifiable has an owned deferral | `D-R10-SOURCES-1` annotated OPEN; OCR + real-URL pilot inside it; `execution_state` amendment owned by the next schema/vocab ticket (recorded on the row) | MET |
| ADR for decisions | ADR-131 + Appendix F + index | MET |

Residual honest limitations (recorded, not hidden): the ten content fixtures
are **representative stand-ins**, not upstream captures — real published-URL
verification is owed inside `D-R10-SOURCES-1` (fixture shapes reproduce the
reviewed artifacts' clauses/blanks without re-hosting bytes); the
`instrument_execution_state` predicate is a recorded proposal, not landed
vocabulary; OCR/image-only documents are outside the ≤2-protocol contract
and fail explicitly today.
